title: 4 signs a rescue video is staged
caption:
A fake rescue is animal abuse with a happy ending edited on.

Cats were the most-featured animals (42%), followed by primates, dogs, snakes and turtles. Don't share, comment on or rewatch them — engagement is what pays.

Source: Social Media Animal Cruelty Coalition, 'Spot the Scam' (2024), via World Animal Protection. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
